clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 2. What a wrong word at SqrtPriceMath.sol:52, :97 or :105 could change. Result: nothing that is committed, because every swap that reaches these lines ends with a specified-currency delta above 2^160 and reverts at Pool.sol:455 or :459 in toInt128.
clearedSpotChecks.note: Read the code myself. SqrtPriceMath.sol:97 (the mulDiv branch of getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount1RoundingDown with add) and :105 (the mulDivRoundingUp branch for subtract) run only for amount > type(uint160).max. getNextSqrtPriceFromInput and getNextSqrtPriceFromOutput (SqrtPriceMath.sol:147-148, :176-177) have no caller in src outside tests except SwapMath.sol:78 (exact input step that exhausts the input, amount = amountRemainingLessFee <= |amountRemaining|) and SwapMath.sol:98 (exact output step with amountOut = amountRemaining). In both cases the remaining specified amount is above 2^160, so |amountSpecified| is above 2^160. Pool.sol:376-381 then sets amountSpecifiedRemaining to 0 for exact input (it adds amountIn + feeAmount, which equals -amountRemaining in that branch, SwapMath.sol:76-82), and Pool.sol:371-374 subtracts amountOut = amountRemaining for exact output, so the loop ends with amountSpecified - amountSpecifiedRemaining = amountSpecified, and toInt128 at Pool.sol:455 or :459 reverts for any magnitude above 2^127. This holds on every network because it follows from the Solidity text, not from the engine. The line 52 bound depends on cycle 25 (L-1079), which I did not re-derive in full; the reasoning in that item is consistent with SqrtPriceMath.sol:45-52 where the fallback runs only when the product overflows or the denominator is smaller than numerator1.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Task 3 and Task 4. 0x5b2e and 0x5bd5 (the price swap in getAmount0Delta, SqrtPriceMath.sol:194) and 0x5d02 (amount == 0 in the exact-output copy of getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount0RoundingUp) cannot be entered.
clearedSpotChecks.note: SqrtPriceMath.sol:194 swaps only when sqrtPriceAX96 > sqrtPriceBX96 strictly. SwapMath.sol:67 and :90 pass (target, current) under zeroForOne = current >= target (SwapMath.sol:60); :86 passes (current, next) when !zeroForOne, where next is at or above current; :101 passes (next, current) when zeroForOne, where next is at or below current. Equal prices do not take the swap. For Pool.sol:213-221 the tick is the floor of the price's tick, so the current price lies below the price at tickUpper when tick < tickUpper. 0x5d02: the exact-output path calls getNextSqrtPriceFromOutput only with amountOut = uint256(amountRemaining) (SwapMath.sol:96-98), and the loop at Pool.sol:344 runs only while amountSpecifiedRemaining != 0; for exact output it stays at or above 0 because each step subtracts amountOut <= amountRemaining (Pool.sol:371-374). So the amount is always nonzero there. These blocks are unreachable by any caller, and the clearance holds.
